svg.text: Workforce kiosk for an agro-industrial company, fully offline

g.text: Inference runs on the phone, no server round-trip
Liveness check against printed photos, fail-closed
SQLite mirror of 77 Postgres tables for offline use
Postgres Row-Level Security for tenant isolation
Native Swift module for offline ID OCR

svg.text: The same TypeScript core runs on the phone, in VisionCamera worklets and in the admin's browser (onnxruntime-web)
